data.content_ref: inline:{"analogy":null,"claim":"A symmetry-pruned randomized search starting from Batcher's odd-even mergesort network (size 48) is more likely to find a 45-comparator network under a fixed budget than a naive random removal of comparators, because reflection symmetry i -> n-1-i reduces the search space size by a factor of 2 without losing optimality.","counterconditions":[{"case":"Strategy 1 finds a valid 45-comparator network before Strategy 2 under the same budget","eval":"observation"},{"case":"Neither strategy finds a valid 45-comparator network within the fixed budget","eval":"observation"},{"case":"Reflection symmetry does not map valid sorting networks to valid sorting networks of equal size","eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"Simulate a search where we start with Batcher's 48-comparator network.
